title: Insert node before head in Doubly Linked List
statementHtml: Given the head of a doubly linked list and an integer X, insert a node with value X before the head of the linked list and return the head of the modified list.
examples:
Input: head = [1, 2, 3], X = 3

Output: head = [3, 1, 2, 3]

Explanation: 3 was added before the 1st node. Note that the head's value is changed.
constraintsHtml:
• n == Number of nodes in the Linked List
  • 1 <= n <= 100
  • 0 <= ListNode.val <= 100
  • 0 <= X <= 100
